mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal weak consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550 thousand units (HOUST < 550) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (INDPRO < 90) reflects manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal recession risks, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days through combined monetary-labor market stress.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25% AND UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low housing starts (HOUST < 550) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 90) indicate synchronized demand-supply weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550 AND INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.25% in prior 3 months), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over 20 trading days as higher rates suppress equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), S&P 500 forward returns decline over 5 trading days as weak labor conditions directly constrain consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
